It affects every town, county, and state across our nation — including South Carolina.</p> <p>&nbsp;the U.S. House. Growing Our Economy | U.S. Representative Russell Fry Hard-working Americans are paying the price for Democrats’ out-of-control spending spree. Since the Biden administration took office, inflation has risen almost 20% overall.</p> <p>Our national debt has surpassed $34 trillion. Washington can’t keep swiping our country’s credit card and expect Americans to pay for the consequences. Americans don’t get a credit card without a spending limit, and the federal government shouldn’t either.</p> <p>Washington should be focused on restoring America to its greatest potential.</p> <p>We must cut wasteful spending to fight inflation. We must restore America’s energy independence to lower energy prices. We must rein in federal overreach and cut burdensome regulations to support our small businesses. We must restore fiscal sanity to Washington and get our country back on track.</p> <p>Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to help grow our economy.</p> <p><b>H.R. 23 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/23"><b><i>Family and Small Business Taxpayer Protection Act</i></b></a><b> </b>— This legislation would block the Biden administration from unleashing 87,000 new IRS agents to go after families and small businesses and their unprecedented increase in IRS audits. This legislation would also prevent the IRS from using its $80 billion increase to target Americans for the purpose of squeezing even more dollars from the pockets of hard-working Americans. It passed the U.S. House in 2023.</p> <p><b>H.R. 3175 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/3995"><b><i>Regulation Reduction Act of 2023</i></b></a><b> </b>—&nbsp;This legislation would prohibit federal agencies from issuing a rule unless the agency has repealed at least two existing rules. Defending Our Constitution | U.S. Representative Russell Fry The Constitution of the United States is our nation’s most important document and it serves as the supreme law of the land. This document has dutifully guided our country through times of change and challenge — and even after over 200 years, it continues to protect the freedoms and rights of We the People.</p> <p>Every American is guaranteed freedom of speech, the right to bear arms, religious liberty, and due process of law because of our Constitution.</p> <p>As the Representative for South Carolina’s Seventh in Washington, I proudly took an oath to protect and defend the Constitution and safeguard the rights of the people of South Carolina’s Seventh and Americans across the country.</p> <p>Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to help defend our Constitution.</p> <p><b>H.J. Res. 8 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-joint-resolution/8"><b><i>Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices</i></b></a> —&nbsp;This resolution would require the Supreme Court to be composed of only nine judges.</p> <p><b>H.R. 140 —</b> <a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/140"><b><i>Protecting Speech from Government Interference Act</i></b></a> —&nbsp;This legislation would aim to prevent censorship by federal government employees influencing third parties to censor the American people. This legislation would protect Americans’ First Amendment rights. This legislation passed the U.S. House in 2023.</p> <p><b>H.R. 646 —</b> <a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/646"><b><i>Stop Harassing Owners of Rifles Today (SHORT) Act </i></b></a>—&nbsp;This legislation would fight back against the Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) federal registry for firearms with stabilizing braces. Providing Government Oversight | U.S. Representative Russell Fry One of the core functions of Congress is oversight and making sure the government is always working for the best interests of the American people.</p> <p>For two years, Democrats and the Biden administration didn’t have to answer to anyone or explain their missteps or outright failures. When House Republicans took the majority in 2022, we restored congressional oversight and immediately began pushing back against this administration and demanding transparency for the American people.</p> <p>Our federal government and its agencies should be efficient and effective — and it should be held accountable when there is waste, fraud and abuse. Americans deserve a government that works for them — not against them.<br /> </p> <p>Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to provide government oversight.</p> <p><b>H.R. 277 —&nbsp;</b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/277"><b><i>REINS Act</i></b></a> —&nbsp;This legislation would reassert Congress’ legislative authority and prevent excessive overreach by the executive branch in the federal rulemaking process. It would require every new “major rule” proposed by federal agencies to be approved by both the House and Senate before going into effect. This legislation defines a “major rule” as any federal rule or regulation that may result in: an annual effect on the economy of $100 million or more; a major increase in costs or prices for consumers, individual industries, government industries, government agencies, or geographic regions; or significant adverse effects on competition, employment, investment, productivity, innovation, or the ability of U.S.-based enterprises to compete with foreign-based enterprises.&nbsp;</p> <p><b>H.R.890 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/890"><b><i>Guidance Out Of Darkness Act</i></b></a> —&nbsp;This legislation would require government agencies to post documents and information related to regulatory guidance on a single website. Protecting Our National Security | U.S. Representative Russell Fry Protecting our national security and keeping Americans safe should always be our government’s top priority. One of my favorite presidents, Teddy Roosevelt, said it best — we must speak softly and carry a big stick.</p> <p>We need a leader in the White House who projects strength on the world stage.</p> <p>We need leadership in our military that prioritizes bolstering our military, not DEI initiatives.</p> <p>America is at a crossroads, and we’re facing threats on multiple fronts — from a hostile China, to the worst border crisis in our nation’s history, to increased unrest in the Middle East — we must be armed and ready to face any threat.</p> <p>Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to help protect our national security.</p> <p><b>H.R. 79 —</b> <a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/79"><b><i>WHO Withdrawal Act</i></b></a> —&nbsp;This legislation would direct the President to withdraw the United States from the World Health Organization.</p> <p><b>H.R. 3774 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/3774"><b><i>Stop Harboring Iranian Petroleum (SHIP) Act</i></b></a><b> </b>— This legislation would impose sanctions on foreign ports and refineries that process petroleum exported from Iran in violation of U.S. sanctions. This legislation passed the U.S. House in 2023.</p> <p><b>H.R. 6114 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/6114"><b><i>Maximum Pressure Act</i></b></a><b> </b>— This legislation would codify the Trump administration’s successful maximum pressure campaign on Iran into law. Sanctions included in this legislation would strip Iran’s ability to fund terrorism throughout the region, sanction the Supreme Leader of Iran, and force the President to enforce sanctions on Iran’s oil sales.&nbsp; </p> <style> </style> <br /> <style> </style>" /> Skip to Content Protecting Our National Security Share on Facebook

Supporting Our Veterans | U.S. Representative Russell Fry Our veterans are our nation’s heroes. Freedom is not free, and we would not be here today as a nation without our veterans’ sacrifice to protect and defend our country.</p> <p>South Carolina’s Seventh is home to well over 50,000 veterans. Our office is here to serve all of our SC-07 veterans. We can assist in working with the Department of Veterans Affairs on claim status, obtaining military medical and service records, helping to solve problems with VA medical center and community care appointments, and more.</p> <p>As we support our troops when they are defending our country, we should equally support them when they return home and provide a robust system of support for them and their families.</p> <p>Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to support our veterans.</p> <p><b>H.R. 366 — the</b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/366"><b><i> Korean American VALOR Ac</i></b></a><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/366"><i>t</i></a> — This legislation allows veterans who served in the armed forces of the Republic of Korea during the Vietnam War, and have since become naturalized U.S. citizens, to become eligible for healthcare services through the Department of Veterans Affairs. This legislation was signed into law in 2023.</p> <p><b>H.R. 1226 —<i> </i>the </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/1226"><b><i>Wounded Warrior Access Act</i></b></a><b><i> </i></b>—&nbsp;This legislation requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to establish and maintain a website to enable claimants to request records related to VA claims and benefits. This legislation was signed into law in 2023.</p> <p><b>H.R. 1282 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/1282"><b><i>Major Richard Star Act</i></b></a> — This legislation would allow combat-wounded veterans with less than 20 years of service both their disability c

Supporting Our Farmers | U.S. Representative Russell Fry Farmers and ranchers are the backbone of America, and food security is a part of our national security.</p> <p>Anything is better if it’s grown and produced in America — and with nearly a million acres of farmland in South Carolina’s Seventh, a lot of it is done in parts of the Grand Strand and Pee Dee.</p> <p>We must always promote policies that support our farmers and ranchers who dedicate their lives to put food on our tables — not bombard them with red tape and overregulation.</p> <p>I will always work to support farmers to make our agriculture industry one that continues to flourish. Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to support our farmers.</p> <p><b>H.J.Res. 27 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-joint-resolution/27"><b><i>Resolution providing for congressional disapproval of the rule submitted by the Department of the Army, Corps of Engineers, Department of Defense, and the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Revised Definition of 'Waters of the United States'” (WOTUS)</i></b></a> — This resolution would have overturned the Biden administration’s overreaching Waters of the United States (WOTUS) rule. This rule created confusing and burdensome red tape for farmers across the country. This legislation was passed in both the U.S. House and Senate, but was vetoed by President Biden.</p> <p><b>H.R. 5044 — </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/5044"><b><i>Timber Innovation for Building Rural Communities Act</i></b></a> — This legislation would aim to find new and innovative uses for wood as a building material by establishing two grant programs and one pilot program designed to accelerate the research and development of wood for use in construction projects. Regaining Our Energy Independence | U.S. Representative Russell Fry Energy security is national security.</p> <p>When the Biden administration took office, they waged war on our country’s energy independence — leaving America reliant on foreign countries, including some of our adversaries, for oil and gas.</p> <p>This administration’s extreme regulations continue to stunt America’s economic growth, raise energy prices, and cripple domestic energy production. They continue to prioritize woke environmentalists at the expense of hard-working Americans.</p> <p>House Republicans passed H.R. 1 – the <i>Lower Energy Costs Act</i>, which would bolster domestic energy production and reverse many of this administration’s anti-energy policies. We have pushed back against this administration’s anti-energy policies, and have passed several pieces of pro-energy legislation to reestablish American energy independence.</p> <p>Americans are paying the price for the Biden administration’s war on our energy production. We must unleash America’s energy potential to lower costs, grow our economy, and stop having to rely on foreign dictators for energy.</p> <p>Below are a few highlights of legislation I have supported to help regain our energy independence.</p> <p><b>H.R. 1 — the </b><a href="https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/1"><b><i>Lower Energy Costs Act</i></b></a><b> —</b> This legislation would restore American energy independence by increasing domestic energy production, reforming the permitting process for all industries, reversing the anti-energy policies advanced by the Biden administration, and boosting the production and processing of critical minerals.
